summary: Candidate is a specialized database-framework-specific instance of the broader 'Dependency Compatibility Assessment' skill. Both operate in dependency_management task_family during Spring Boot 2.7.x→3.0.x upgrade. The candidate focuses narrowly on four database frameworks (Flyway, Liquibase, Hibernate, R2DBC) while the peer skill covers all managed and unmanaged dependencies. The candidate should merge into the existing broader skill as a detailed intervention move or constraint, avoiding duplication of the core compatibility assessment workflow.
